decks.notes: This deck focuses on playing aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis early in the game, while utilizing cards like Vengevine and Bloodghast to keep up the pressure. The deck also takes advantage of graveyard synergies with Stitcher's Supplier and Deathrite Shaman to fuel its quick and powerful plays. Additionally, the inclusion of disruptive cards like Force of Vigor and efficient mana acceleration like Mox Emerald and Mox Jet help maintain its aggressive game plan. The deck's land base includes key utility lands like Bazaar of Baghdad and Wasteland to further support its aggressive strategy.

Utilizing a combination of counterspells, card draw, tutors, and powerful artifacts, this Grixis Control deck aims to disrupt opponents' strategies while developing its own win condition. The deck includes key cards such as Ancestral Recall, Force of Will, Demonic Tutor, and Bolas's Citadel to provide card advantage and control the game. With access to powerful artifacts like Time Vault and Underworld Breach, as well as disruptive creatures like Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher, the deck seeks to outvalue opponents and secure victory through a combination of card advantage and controlling the game state.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to quickly and efficiently fill the graveyard with creatures and trigger powerful effects. By stocking the graveyard with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll and Stinkweed Imp, the deck can constantly recur threats like Narcomoeba and Prized Amalgam. This enables the player to quickly overwhelm their opponent with a swarm of creatures and take advantage of powerful cards like Creeping Chill. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will and Force of Negation to protect its combo pieces.

This deck focuses on utilizing cards like Bazaar of Baghdad and Stitcher's Supplier to fill the graveyard quickly, allowing for powerful graveyard-dependent creatures like Hogaak, Vengevine, and Bloodghast to come back repeatedly. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a fast, aggressive strategy while also having ways to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Force of Vigor. The inclusion of cards like Once Upon a Time and Hollow One provide additional consistency and speed to the deck, allowing for explosive starts and powerful board presence.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the Dredge mechanic to fill the graveyard quickly with cards like Golgari Grave-Troll, Stinkweed Imp, and Shambling Shell. This allows for explosive plays by recurring creatures such as Ichorid and Prized Amalgam, creating a strong board presence. The inclusion of cards like Creeping Chill and Hollow One also helps to apply pressure on the opponent. The deck also includes disruption in the form of Force of Will, Force of Vigor, and Mental Misstep to protect the combo. Bazaar of Baghdad is used for additional card selection and graveyard filling.

The main concept of this deck is to aggressively control the board with efficient counterspells and removal while utilizing card advantage and powerful equipment to close out the game quickly. By disrupting opponents with counterspells like Force of Will and Flusterstorm, and removing threats with Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to protect its own threats like Monastery Mentor and Kaldra Compleat. The equipment package, including Sword of Fire and Ice, enhances the aggression and provides additional card advantage. Additionally, the deck leverages Narset, Parter of Veils and Hullbreacher to further disrupt opponents and gain card advantage.

This deck focuses on utilizing efficient creatures and disruptive spells to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board. By leveraging powerful cards like Tarmogoyf, Wrenn and Six, and Collector Ouphe, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building incremental advantage through card advantage and resource denial. With a focus on tempo and disruption, this deck seeks to outmaneuver the opponent and secure victory through a combination of aggressive early threats and powerful late-game spells.

The main idea of this deck is to use the Doomsday card in combination with various tutors and counterspells to set up a winning combo that involves playing Thassa's Oracle to win the game. The deck is focused on quick and efficient card selection and manipulation, utilizing cards like Brainstorm, Preordain, and Ponder to set up the desired sequence of cards. With the right setup and careful planning, the deck can win the game in just a few turns by executing the Doomsday combo.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful combination of cards and spells to generate a high storm count, allowing the player to cast multiple spells in rapid succession and finish the game with a devastating Tendrils of Agony. It includes fast mana sources like Moxen and rituals, along with powerful tutors to find key combo pieces like Bolas's Citadel and Yawgmoth's Will. By efficiently drawing cards, generating mana, and storming off, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The deck focuses on utilizing fast, aggressive creatures such as Archon of Emeria, Luminarch Aspirant, and Thalia to quickly overwhelm the opponent. It also includes disruptive elements like Thalia, Guardian of Thraben and Force of Vigor to slow down the opponent's game plan. The deck also utilizes mana acceleration from cards like Noble Hierarch and Moxen to power out its threats early. Additionally, the deck includes hate cards like Chalice of the Void and Boseiju, Who Endures to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The mana base is designed to provide consistent colored mana sources while also including disruptive lands like Wasteland and Strip Mine.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly fill up the graveyard with creatures using cards like Stitcher's Supplier and Bazaar of Baghdad, allowing for early Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis to hit the battlefield. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Hollow One, while also having disruption with Deathrite Shaman and Force of Vigor. The deck also utilizes cards like Once Upon a Time to find key pieces and has mana acceleration with Black Lotus and Moxen.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble the combo of Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage to create a 20/20 Marit Lage token quickly and efficiently. The deck uses various cards such as Crop Rotation, Sylvan Scrying, and Elvish Reclaimer to search for the combo pieces while also utilizing mana acceleration from cards like Elvish Spirit Guide and Moxen. Additionally, the deck includes disruptive elements like Pithing Needle and Force of Vigor to protect the combo and disrupt opponents' strategies. The goal is to quickly assemble the combo and overwhelm the opponent with a powerful Marit Lage token.

The main idea of this deck is to quickly and aggressively play creatures like Basking Rootwalla, Blazing Rootwalla, and Vengevine, utilizing the graveyard with cards like Master of Death and Squee, Goblin Nabob. The deck also includes cards like Force of Negation, Force of Vigor, and Force of Will to control the board and protect its own threats. Noxious Revival is used to recur key cards from the graveyard, while Bazaar of Baghdad helps with card selection and filling up the graveyard. Overall, this deck focuses on fast, high-powered plays to overwhelm the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with creatures like Basking Rootwalla and Blazing Rootwalla to enable powerful graveyard synergies with cards like Bloodghast and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis. Using cards like Vengevine and Hollow One, the deck aims to apply early pressure and overwhelm the opponent before they can establish their own game plan. Additionally, the deck utilizes disruptive cards like Force of Vigor to deal with opposing threats while also having powerful ramp with cards like Black Lotus and Moxen to accelerate its game plan.

This deck focuses on assembling the Doomsday combo to win the game. It utilizes cards like Street Wraith, Thassa's Oracle, and Demonic Consultation to set up the win condition. The deck also includes a variety of cantrips and tutors to dig through the deck quickly, along with disruption like Force of Will and Flusterstorm to protect the combo. With the ability to win the game quickly and efficiently, this deck aims to be a powerful force in the Vintage 1vs1 format.

This deck focuses on quickly deploying powerful artifacts to disrupt the opponent's game plan and lock them out of the game. With cards like Phyrexian Revoker, Chalice of the Void, and Sphere of Resistance, it aims to slow down the opponent while generating value with cards like Golos, Tireless Pilgrim and Mystic Forge. The deck also has a strong mana denial package with cards like Ghost Quarter and Wasteland, and can tutor for key artifacts with cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Inventors' Fair. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with efficient artifact threats and disruption.
